verdict: Spend has collapsed to near-zero with no visible leads — the campaign is effectively paused and needs intervention.
diagnosis: Total spend of $2,330 over 28 days averages $13.63 daily, but the latest day dropped to $3.85 — well below viable thresholds.

signals.headline: Daily spend crashed to $3.85
signals.detail: Latest day sits far below the 28-day average of $13.63. Delivery has effectively stalled on the PCOS and postpartum campaign.

signals.headline: Only 1 active campaign running
signals.detail: The persona campaign carries the whole account. No backup campaign exists to absorb budget or test alternative angles.

signals.headline: 28-day spend totals $2,330
signals.detail: Below the $1,500 monthly floor many benchmarks cite for meaningful studio results. Volume is too thin to judge creative.

signals.headline: Zero lead data visible this period
signals.detail: No conversion, pipeline, or booking data flowing in. Impossible to confirm whether spend is producing qualified prospects.

recommendations.title: Restore daily budget to at least $30–$50
recommendations.detail: Current pace of $3.85 per day cannot exit Meta's learning phase. Consider rebuilding to a minimum viable budget before judging creative or audience.

recommendations.title: Connect lead tracking before scaling further
recommendations.detail: No lead, booking, or pipeline data is visible this period. Worth confirming the lead form, CRM, and conversion events are firing correctly.

recommendations.title: Test a second creative angle alongside PCOS persona
recommendations.detail: One campaign carries everything right now. Consider testing a general trial-class offer to compare cost per lead against the persona angle.
